rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the exact unit of length.

example.english: We walked one mile before taking a break.
example.traditional: 我哋行咗一英里先歇一歇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haang4 zo2 jat1 jing1 lei5 sin1 hit3 jat1 hit3

rows.note: Use this casual spoken alternative when referring to the exact unit of length.

example.english: It’s almost a mile from here to the MTR station.
example.traditional: 由呢度行到地鐵站，差唔多一咪。
example.jyutping: jau4 ni1 dou6 haang4 dou3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 caa1 m4 do1 jat1 mai1

rows.note: Use this for a very large distance rather than a precise measurement.

example.english: It’s a good mile from home to the airport.
example.traditional: 由屋企去機場真係一大段距離。
example.jyutping: jau4 uk1 kei2 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 zan1 hai6 jat1 daai6 dyun6 keoi5 lei4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a race covering one mile.

example.english: They signed up for a race covering one mile.
example.traditional: 佢報名參加一英里長跑。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bou3 ming4 caam1 gaa1 jat1 jing1 lei5 coeng4 paau2
